steps.js: const sel=[...document.querySelectorAll('.ds-modal select')]; const who=sel.find(s=>s.getAttribute('aria-label')==='谁的装备'); if (who && !who.value && who.options.length>1) { who.value=who.options[1].value; who.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})); } return {mode:document.querySelector('.regen-mode')?.innerText, selects:sel.map(s=>s.getAttribute('aria-label')+'='+(s.options[s.selectedIndex]?.text||'')), submitDisabled:[...document.querySelectorAll('.ds-modal button')].find(b=>b.innerText.trim()==='生成')?.disabled}

steps.clickAt: (() => { const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>/再生成/.test(b.innerText) && /尾帧/.test(b.title) && b.getBoundingClientRect().width>0); const r=b?.getBoundingClientRect(); return r?[r.x+r.width/2,r.y+r.height/2]:[null,null]; })()
